description: Identical event set to fixture 01, but shuffled submission order and flagged as a replay. Final resolved state and every conflict_decisions row must be byte-identical to fixture 01's outcome, proving the resolver is order-independent (canonical order is derived from event_timestamp+source+id, never submission order).

expectedOutcomes.note: Run tests/determinism.test.ts comparing the final drone_state_versions and conflict_decisions for drone-alpha against the result of replaying fixture 01. They must be deep-equal aside from ingested_at/created_at wall-clock columns.
